comment: wb-021.5 (MW-ADAPTIVE-POLICY-ORGANIZATIONS-R7; the hk9l/5jha/1xvp.4/o4h0.3 roster pattern): the OUT-OF-FILE anchor of test/workbench-apo-rerender-census.test.ts (cut #2). rows: every judged row of test/helpers/apo-rerender-census.ts in census order (SURFACES, ADMISSION, INVOCATION, EFFECT, IDENTITY, QUIET, READERS, ABSENCE, REACH, NAMES) - table, id, label, the SHA-256 of each case as written (JSON of the case: its input and its expected reading) and the registered test. nonRender: the named non-render readers, each with its measured member references (value, type) and its reason. tests: every test the census file registers, in order. residuals: the named residual families and their pinned quiet rows. Written from the rows as measured at the cut; the census judges its tables, its non-render readers, its registered tests (vitest task tree, run modes and timeouts) and its residual families against this file at test time, in order and both ways. It is a literal authored in the same cut, not a source of truth: a hollow that also edits this file is not caught here. The outside anchors are src (the modules that reach the projection, the non-render readers' member references and runtime closure, the render modules' references, the projection's public members, the registry's effect classes and the dialog's actions) and the bead's own export row (.beads/issues.jsonl, wb-021.5: the title and the owner filing), so a SURFACES row, a NON_RENDER entry, an admission plant, an effect-class plant or a dialog-action plant removed from the census and this file together still reds.

rows.label: the graph-view model, built and rebuilt by its cached builder, reads quiet over N refreshes
the timeline lanes at two zoom and pan settings read quiet over N refreshes
the model-facing observe reply, bare and with relations and events, reads quiet over N refreshes
the linked topology slice of two focused nodes reads quiet over N refreshes
the attention report at two bottleneck caps reads quiet over N refreshes
the latency decomposition reads quiet over N refreshes
the operations telemetry report reads quiet over N refreshes
the inspector layout of each of the four views reads quiet over N redraws
the real host seam's dialog redraw of each of the four views, its per-redraw model builders included, reads quiet over N redraws
each read member of the projection itself reads quiet over N re-projections
a render that calls any admission member of the projection is read by the tap and by the state digest
a property written through the tap, and a write that bypasses the tap, are each read
a render that invokes a capability of any effect class is read as an attempt, a provider call and a registry admission
an inspect, an invoke of an unregistered capability, an evidence load and an invoke deferred to the next immediate, each started by a render, are read
residual: an invocation a render schedules past the judge's settle window reads quiet
a render that performs the host effect of any dialog action is read
a render that aborts one evidence load or every load is read
residual: an effect through a channel the world does not hold reads quiet
renders that carry a frame counter, reorder their keys or carry a random token are read as not byte-identical

renders whose drift JSON does not encode - a Map, a Set, a WeakMap, a symbol-keyed or non-enumerable counter, an undefined field that comes and goes, a -0, a NaN, a bigint counter, a swapped class - are read as not byte-identical
residual: drift that first appears after N renders reads quiet
residual: drift held where neither encoding reads - behind a getter neither invokes (a prototype accessor, a non-enumerable own accessor), in a closure's captured state - reads quiet
a constant render, a window read and a render that calls every read member read quiet
a typed reader that picks read members only, alone, partial or intersected, reads no writer
a typed reader that keeps an admission member is read as a writer, through Partial, an interface or a qualified name
an Omit keeps every admission member it does not name, and keys that are not literals fail closed

an indexed access into the class keeps the members it names (an admission member read as a writer, a read member as a reader, a non-literal key closed), and a member's statement or result type (Parameters, ReturnType) keeps none
a Pick in a heritage clause, and a Pick over the class through parentheses, an import type or an intersection, are read
residual: a parameter typed as the whole projection, or a typeof query over a value that holds it, is not a typed reader to this scan
residual: a Pick over an alias of the projection class, over its instance type, or through an alias of the utility is not read
the abbreviation as a word, inside an identifier or before a digit, and the slug in any case or separator, are mentions
words that only contain the letters, and the slug's words incomplete or out of order, are not mentions
residual: a paraphrase of the program and the abbreviation spelled with separators are not mentions
a module that names the class through a namespace import, an aliased import, a re-export chain or a plain import reaches the projection

a module that never names the class but holds it through what carries it - a render model's member call, a pass-through, an optional chain, a call's result, a container (an array, a keyed map), a function or a getter that yields it - reaches the projection

a destructured member (a binding or an assignment pattern), an element access, a typeof query, an indexed access and a member's statement or result type (Parameters, ReturnType) each reach the projection
residual: a module that reaches the projection only through an erased or structural type - a cast from unknown, a structural interface of its own, Reflect, an any - reads as reaching nothing
a public member of the class is read under any name form - a string or numeric literal, a computed literal, template or constant, a symbol

every public instance member kind is read - an arrow property, a field, an accessor pair, a parameter property, a merged, an inherited and an augmented member - private, protected, #private and static members are not, and an index signature fails closed
every member of the actions interface is read under any name form, inherited and merged members included, and a call, construct or index signature fails closed
residual: a member patched onto the class's prototype at run time is not read - the readers read the declared class and interface

live (armed): every src module that reaches the projection - it names the class, references a member or holds a declaration that carries it, as the checker resolves names - is a SURFACES module or a named non-render reader
live (armed): each named non-render reader references exactly the members its entry names, and none is in the runtime import closure of the SURFACES modules
live: the SURFACES modules reference read members of the projection only, in value and type positions, as the checker resolves them
live: the projection's public instance members, as the checker reads the class (every member kind and name form), are exactly the read and admission members, each planted or re-projected
live: the invocation plants invoke every effect class the registry's descriptor declares
live: the effect plants perform every WorkflowDialogActions member, as the checker reads the interface (every name form, inherited and merged members; signatures fail closed)
live: no src module spells the program, by path or text; the walk is every src module
